g.text: Per-gene Spearman rho; dashed lines are medians
lncRNA genes track the metric more
Discovery axis projected onto the set
Spearman rho with the non-feature fraction (magnitude where the sign is a convention)
Spearman rho with the non-feature fraction; 6 sample sets, both expression matrices, both axis definitions; the
projected lncRNA correlation is positive at p < 0.05 in 6 of them. The lncRNA specificity is a poly(A) finding:
within a sample set the projected lncRNA rho exceeds the projected protein-coding rho by 0.30 to 0.84 in the 4
poly(A) sets and 0.05 to 0.25 in the 2 ribo-depleted sets, and in CPTAC-3, matched normal it is 0.43 against 0.39,
which is almost no contrast. The protocol difference is graded, not categorical: the weakest poly(A) set (TCGA-KICH
tumour, 0.594) sits beside the strongest ribo-depleted set (CPTAC-3 tumour, 0.545). 3 own-component rows whose sign
is a convention rather than a finding are drawn as magnitudes (open symbols).
The projected lncRNA axis tracks the metric in 6 of 6 sample sets, and the protocol difference
+ age, sex, T, N, M1, ordinal
Nested Cox models, 503 patients, 163 deaths; p < 0.05 in 5 of 8 models
